policy: Preserved verbatim per Law 1 (recall over tidiness). These were parked by the pattern-matcher for human/spec review and are NOT noise-filtered. Dedup cross-references and overlap annotations added in 'dedupAnnotation'.

items.description: Two-step APY commit: step1 arms (pendingAPYBps/pendingAPYBlockNumber/apySetInProgress), step2 commits if same bps within the window (block.number > pendingAPYBlockNumber + 100 -> treated as preview). The committed value is the step-2 bps with an equality check against the step-1 snapshot (bps != pendingAPYBps), and the commit branch settles accrual via _updatePool() at the OLD rate before applying the new APY (line 165) - both notVulnerableWhen conditions hold. Caveats kept for review: (a) there is NO minimum block gap - both steps can execute in the SAME block/transaction (isPreview evaluates false when apySetInProgress && bps==pending && block.number==pendingAPYBlockNumber), weakening the two-step as a fat-finger / observation guard; (b) the +100 window is inclusive (commit allowed at exactly +100 blocks); (c) setDesiredAPY is onlyOwner so there is no third-party re-arm/grief vector.
items.rationale: Mostly matches notVulnerableWhen (snapshot equality + settle-before-apply). Same-block commit is a weakening of the intended safety but the story only requires 'two calls within 100 blocks'. QA-grade; parked for human/spec review (Law 2 faithfulness to the two-step intent).
items.dedupAnnotation: Corroborated by Tier-3 halmos TwoStepAPYGate proofs (fresh-state-always-preview, window-expiry-preview, bps-mismatch-preview, commit-requires-exact-tuple, +100 inclusive, +101 excluded -- all PASS): the gate behaves as designed. Faithfulness scanner rated story-014 FAITHFUL. The residual same-block weakening overlaps ledger L-02/L-03 and ECON-CLEAR-APY. No standalone consolidated finding raised; remains a QA/spec-review item.

items.description: phUSDPerSecond = (totalStaked * desiredAPYBps) / 10000 / SECONDS_PER_YEAR is a multiply followed by two chained integer divisions (floor). For very small totalStaked (near MINIMUM_STAKE=1e15) combined with a low APY, the per-second emission can floor to 0, silently zeroing phUSD emissions despite a non-zero configured APY. Not strict div-before-mul (the multiply precedes the divides), but the compounded flooring is a precision concern. All other reward math (rewardPerSecond, accPerShare, debt) multiplies by PRECISION before dividing, so precision is preserved there.
items.rationale: Rounding-down favors the protocol and only bites at extreme small-stake/low-APY corners; QA-grade. Parked for completeness.
items.dedupAnnotation: Maps to ledger L-13. Tier-3 halmos PROVED nonzero above MINIMUM_STAKE (1e15) with bps>=1, and CONFIRMED zeroing only in the dust regime -- which is reachable on-chain only once pauseWithdraw breaks INV-6 (DEDUP-007 / LOCAL-005). So the on-chain reachability of the floor-to-zero is folded into DEDUP-007; the general low-stake/low-APY QA note remains here / at ledger L-13.

items.description: emergencyTransfer(recipient) is onlyOwner and moves ALL phUSD (including staked user principal) and ALL rewardToken to an owner-chosen recipient, then pauses. After it runs, pauseWithdraw (the user escape hatch) reverts because the contract holds no phUSD to transfer. 'Malicious owner rug' is out of scope (Law 3, owner trusted). Parked as a visibility note: the interaction where the owner's emergency action drains the very balance the user escape hatch depends on is a potential operational footgun, though it is largely an obvious consequence of 'move all tokens' (design decision: 'Emergency transfer pauses contract and moves all tokens to recipient').
items.rationale: Pattern note says C4 treats centralization as Low/QA unless rug. Leans owner-trust/obvious -> likely suppress per Law 3, but parked visibly rather than dropped (Law 1 recall).
items.dedupAnnotation: The obvious 'drain bricks pauseWithdraw' facet is the FAITHFULNESS deviation DEDUP-008 (F-002, Law-2). The NON-obvious, in-scope escalation (pauser==0 -> permanent pause + dead escape + non-zeroed accounting) is DEDUP-006 (LOCAL-006 + CODE-004 + ledger C-02). Retained here as the centralization-lens view.

items.description: Empty-pool special handling matched (if (totalStaked == 0) at lines 394 and 462). However the classic first-depositor / ERC4626 share-inflation does NOT apply: staking is 1:1 (user.amount tracks raw phUSD wei, there is NO share-price / exchange-rate math and no donate-to-inflate vector), and a MINIMUM_STAKE = 1e15 floor is enforced on stake (line 296). ERC4626-INFLATION is likewise N/A (no deposit(assets,receiver), no shares = assets*totalSupply/totalAssets).
items.rationale: Signature matched, mitigations present (MINIMUM_STAKE + 1:1 accounting). Not vulnerable; recorded as checked-and-cleared for recall/audit-trail, not as an actionable finding.
items.dedupAnnotation: Concurs with ECON-CLEAR-FIRSTDEP and the halmos overflow-boundary non-finding. CHECKED-AND-CLEARED; not an actionable finding. The only residual dust-related concern (pauseWithdraw -> dust totalStaked) is captured by DEDUP-007.

items.description: Stable distribution caps toDistribute at rewardBalance (line 406, 'potentialReward > rewardBalance ? rewardBalance : potentialReward') and accStablePerShare advances only by the capped amount, so stable payouts cannot exceed the funded budget (no insolvency for stable). This is a SILENT cap rather than a _safePay revert (pattern's notVulnerableWhen prefers revert-on-shortfall), and combined with the per-interaction rate recompute (PATTERN-002) the runway is asymptotic. phUSD has no funded budget at all (minted on demand, APY-bounded), so the runway concept does not apply to phUSD. No over-pay path found absent the reentrancy (PATTERN-003).
items.rationale: No insolvency (capped distribution). Parked for visibility because the silent-cap behavior and asymptotic runway interact with PATTERN-002; not an independent actionable finding.
items.dedupAnnotation: The silent-cap is the INV-3/INV-4 mitigation (Tier-3 HELD across 128k forge + 2.0M medusa calls; halmos check_singleStep_distribute_le_balance PASS). The asymptotic-runway interaction is the DEDUP-001 root cause. No independent finding; the no-over-distribution property is a verified-safe property, not a defect.
